name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company headquartered in Reno, Nevada, focused on acquiring and exploring gold properties in the western United States. Its key projects include the Agai-Pah property in Mineral County, Nevada and the Lapon Canyon gold project, which hosts historical high-grade gold mineralization with approximately 2,000 feet of underground workings. The company is in the exploration stage with no current production.
